_comment: 河流城市「妮芙的三分钟」剧本（剧情姐合订稿 in1030/yun1.txt 第 73–152 行）。通讯器用 phone_* 步骤（docs/phone_and_cockpit_contract.md）：鹿借弥洛通讯器留言 river_msg_deer、告别时 phone_add nifu。生成脚本 scratchpad/later/gen_river.py。妮芙的记忆用沙漏 + 轻铃（sfx bell_soft）+ 她的本子（prop niff_notebook）表现，不计时。水下仓库里两人不说话（她说过不要隔着面罩喊）。markers 坐标都是占位 0。带 "added": true 的是补写。 10-30：飞行一结尾改成往前一冲进黑色星空、第一章结束（不再降落），原文 71–72 的降落（城市沿水道铺开……趴在操纵台上缓了一会儿）挪到 start_river 开头：晨先藏起来，河岸画面淡入时用 narr 念完、配推进器关掉 / 撞浮木的声音，晨说「行。至少到了。」以后再从舱门出来。手改的，重新跑生成脚本会丢，要一起改进去。 10-30 河岸第三版（作者要孤独感）：start_river 到晨出舱为止（设 river_ashore），晨先一个人沿河岸走一大段，走到箱子跟前才触发 bank_meet（hotspot meet_niff：trigger enter + cutscene，台词原样搬过去）；bank_cup 里补了阿汀 / 妮芙 / 晨走回飞机那边的 walk，结尾妮芙先往家那边走（river_bank_niff）。也是手改的。

Go back to Niff's to say goodbye

objectives.zh: 去南桥，走到影像和桥对上
objectives.en: At South Bridge, line the footage up with the bridge

objectives.zh: 去妮芙家二楼修影像盒
objectives.en: Fix the footage box upstairs at Niff's

objectives.zh: 去旧街的水下仓库找读取头
objectives.en: Find the reading head in the flooded warehouse on Old Street
Help Niff fish out what drifted off

lines.en: The ship's right by the bank.

lines.zh: 先回妮芙家说再见，再修飞机。
lines.en: Say goodbye at Niff's first, then fix the ship.
Got the ship number. Head back.
The footprints lead into the channel.

lines.zh: 南桥在旧街那头，一直往右走。
lines.en: South Bridge is past the far end of Old Street. Keep going right.

lines.zh: 影像盒在二楼的播放器旁边。
lines.en: The footage box is by the player upstairs.

lines.zh: 仓库入口在水下。跟着导绳走。
lines.en: The warehouse entrance is underwater. Follow the guide rope.

lines.zh: 台阶还在水下：先听哪边在冒泡，调好水闸。

lines.zh: 旧街在市集楼下：先去高处市集，再下楼。
lines.en: Old Street is below the market. Go up to the market, then downstairs.
Niff's house is right on the bank.

side_objectives.zh: 把影像盒拿给阿汀看看
side_objectives.en: Show the footage box to Ting

side_objectives.zh: 跟市集的鼠妈换点吃的
side_objectives.en: Trade with Mama Rat at the market

side_objectives.zh: 看看窗边的来客册干了没
side_objectives.en: See if the guestbook by the window is dry

rat_chef._note: 10-31 以物易物（scripts/barter.gd），作者按 docs/以物易物交换表.md 定稿。flag：barter_rat_chef_<id>；recipe 要先换过大嘴鸟的尾羽（森林带过来的 barter_toucan_feather）。

hotspots._note: 10-31 range 56 → 74：晨跑过来触发后还要往前滑 15 像素，56 的话停在离妮芙 41（鲸鱼壳要 57），她转正浮起来时压到晨
10-31 作者：市集和旧街之间加一间楼梯间（旧街被水淹、比市集低，不能直接平移过去）。市集右头的门 → 楼梯间 → 石阶往下 → 旧街

rat_chef_hello.zh: 站风口做什么，过来，锅边暖和。拿用不上的东西来添锅，我给你包点路上吃的。
rat_chef_hello.en: Why stand in the wind? Come by the pot. Bring me something you don't need, and I'll pack you food for the road.

rat_chef_wrong.zh: 这个可下不了锅。收好，别弄丢了。
rat_chef_wrong.en: That won't go in a pot. Keep it safe, don't lose it.

rat_chef_none.zh: 不急。饿了就回来，锅一直在这儿。
rat_chef_none.en: No hurry. Come back when you're hungry. The pot's always here.

rat_chef_react_biscuits.zh: 谁烤的饼干？糖放得真省。你留着吧，是人家的心意。
rat_chef_react_biscuits.en: Who baked these? Stingy with the sugar. Keep them, someone made them for you.

rat_chef_take_driftwood.zh: 晾得这么干的浮木！给你灌一壶汤，路上冷了就喝。
rat_chef_take_driftwood.en: Driftwood this dry! Here, a flask of soup. Drink it when you get cold.

rat_chef_take_feather.zh: 大嘴鸟的羽毛？它年轻时欠我一锅汤。这做法你替我收着。
rat_chef_take_feather.en: The big-beaked bird's feather? It owes me a pot of soup from way back. Keep this recipe for me.

rat_chef_take_wood.zh: 这木头一直不灭？给我的灶吧。饭团包了三个，一个今天吃。
rat_chef_take_wood.en: This wood never goes out? Give it to my stove. Three rice balls. Eat one today.

rat_chef_done.zh: 锅里的你都尝过了。路上慢点走，别饿着。
rat_chef_done.en: You've tasted everything in the pot. Go easy on the road, and don't go hungry.

narr.zh: 河流星。城市沿着水道铺开，细桥连着屋顶，低处的街道泛着水光。
narr.en: The river planet. The city spread out along its waterways, thin bridges linking the rooftops, the low streets shining with water.

narr.zh: 飞机撞散一片浮木，卡进一条窄水道。
narr.en: The plane broke through a raft of driftwood and wedged itself into a narrow channel.

start_river.en: Okay. At least I made it.

start_river._note: 10-30 作者：箱子后面的尾巴别另画、别凭空冒出来——妮芙原图斜着扎在箱子后面翻东西，只露出鲸鱼壳的尾巴；晨走过来远远就看得到
10-30 作者：晨在飞机那里突然出现很奇怪——舱门响了以后淡出来，再自己走两步下来

bank_meet._note: 撤掉河岸 walk_when 的墙（打捞时东西漂到下游浅滩 1250，要走过去捞）
10-30 作者：用原角色转过来——扎在箱子后面的妮芙慢慢转正、浮起来，再从箱子后面飘出来

bank_meet.en: Oh? Are you here to pick something up?

options.en: I... just fell out of the sky.
Yes. I'm here to pick up a package.
I'm here to write your biography.
I'm your mom.

bank_meet._note: 11-02 本2兔式离谱选项（作者「要有一些能改变后续东西的，比如叫妈妈」）：选了什么，妮芙本子上就记成什么，这一章她都这么叫晨；终章她的消息也这么叫

bank_meet_b._note: 10-31 作者「我往前这个鱼就会往后，走得很远」：晨去台阶 / 去捞东西时从妮芙身上走过去，鲸鱼壳悬浮让路就被晨一路推着往下游退。她先自己飘到台阶下游那边，捞东西时再去浅滩下游（lines.start）等着，晨的路上没有她
走路的速度（55）比妮芙飘（70）慢：跟在她后面，追不上她、不催她

bank_meet_b.zh: 那只杯子快漂走啦，先拿它。
bank_meet_b.en: That cup's floating off. Grab it first.

bank_meet_b.spec: 【小游戏：顺着水流打捞收藏品和修船材料。水声与碰撞声提示物品方向，漂浮轨迹提供同步视觉信息。不同物品具有不同浮力，玩家需要判断打捞顺序；错过的关键物品会停在下游浅滩，玩家可以在那里继续打捞。】

start._note: 10-31 作者「不知道要干嘛」：晨先回头看上游（镜头跟着往左，漂着的东西进画面），妮芙说清楚怎么捞、捞哪个，再飘去浅滩下游接着

start.zh: 你拿钩子够，我去下游接着。先捞会沉的哦。
start.en: You hook them, I'll catch them downstream. Sinking ones first.

hint_sink.en: That one's riding low. It's about to sink.

sank_1.zh: 没关系，它们会在底下等我的。
sank_1.en: That's okay. They'll wait for me down there.

give_some.zh: 沉下去的，等水退了再来接它们。
give_some.en: The ones that sank, I'll come for when the water's down.

bank_meet_b._note: 10-31 拿着接头往飞机那边走回几步（上游）。也给阿汀留出地方：他要从晨和妮芙（下游 1330）中间的水里上来（晨右边至少 85、妮芙左边至少 108，一共 193），原来晨停在浅滩 1250、妮芙在 1305，中间站不下，引擎把阿汀放到晨左边，晨去舱门的路被他挡住、一步没走

n_meet_bio.zh: 终于有人来了！第一章：妮芙小姐掉了一箱东西。
n_meet_bio.en: Finally! Chapter One: Miss Niff Drops a Crate.

n_meet_mom.zh: 妮芙小姐的妈妈在下游开船，她比你湿。
n_meet_mom.en: Miss Niff's mom runs a boat downstream. She's wetter than you.

narr.zh: 杯底贴着一张旧纸条：「借给妮芙，下次来拿。」
narr.en: An old note is stuck under the cup: "Lent to Niff. Will come back for it."

bank_cup._note: 11-02 作者「阿汀的出场好奇怪……不是有移动的动画吗」「等阿汀走到飞船 took forever」：不再从水里浮上来、也不再从妮芙旁边走 700 多像素。绳子丢过来，晨走到舱门，他从画面右边外面走进来，只走一小段（约 3.6 秒，淡入着进画面，他自己的走路动画 100ms 一帧）。晨在舱门 196、他停在 river_bank_ting 360：人不叠、谁也不从谁身上穿过去

bank_cup.zh: 站住。河岸条例第一条：飞机不许掉进河里。
bank_cup.en: Halt. Riverbank Regulation One: no planes in the river.

bank_cup.zh: 第二条：已经掉了的，先把机翼绑住。
bank_cup.en: Regulation Two: if it's already in, tie the wings down first.

bank_cup._note: 11-02 作者：拖上岸不要闪现，带红色泛光挪过去（story_runner._prop_glide）

bank_cup.zh: 第四条：湿的东西不许拆。你现在拆，里面外面一起湿。
bank_cup.en: Regulation Four: nothing wet gets taken apart. Open it now and it's wet inside and out.
All hung up. Come on, to my place.

n_ting_mom.zh: 第三条：不许随便给妮芙当妈。……这条刚加的。
n_ting_mom.en: Regulation Three: no one gets to be Niff's mom on a whim. ...That one's new.

n_name_p.zh: 我就是妮芙。叫我妮芙就好，叫‘小姐’听着像我要开始收钱了。
n_name_p.en: That's me, Niff. Just Niff. 'Miss Niff' sounds like I'm about to charge you.

n_name_c.zh: 我就是妮芙。取件员，叫我妮芙就好，叫‘小姐’听着像我要收钱了。
n_name_c.en: That's me, Niff. Just Niff, courier. 'Miss' makes it sound like I'm charging you.

n_name_b.zh: 我就是妮芙小姐。传记里要写全名哦。
n_name_b.en: I am Miss Niff. Use the full name in the biography.

n_name_m.zh: 我就是妮芙。冒牌妈妈，你叫我妮芙就好。
n_name_m.en: That's me, Niff. You can call me Niff, fake mom.

bank_doorplate.zh: 门边的地址和水下的旧门牌，是一个人写的。
bank_doorplate.en: The address by the door and the old plate underwater. Same handwriting.

bank_doorplate.zh: 妮芙门边的新地址和水下的旧门牌，是同一个人写的。
bank_doorplate.en: Niff's address by the door and the old house number underwater are in the same handwriting.

bank_bakery.zh: 面包店搭了块木板，隔着水做生意。
bank_bakery.en: The bakery runs a plank across. Business over the water.

bank_postman.zh: 邮差从屋顶的窄桥上过去了。
bank_postman.en: The mail carrier just crossed the narrow rooftop bridge.

bank_underwater.en: Neat paving stones under the water.

ting_chat_1.zh: 第五条：别摸晾着的飞机。它害羞。
ting_chat_1.en: Regulation Five: don't touch the drying plane. It's shy.

ting_chat_2.zh: 第七条：退水以后再下水。事项写齐了没有？
ting_chat_2.en: Regulation Seven: no diving till the water drops. Is your list done?

ting_chat_4.zh: 第二十条：下回落水，挑深点的地方。浮筒我看过了。
ting_chat_4.en: Regulation Twenty: next time you crash, pick deeper water. I checked the floats.

home_enter._note: 11-02 作者「妮芙还是闪现进门」：她留在河岸的那个位置在世界坐标里正好叠在妮芙家这一间上，晨一进门就看见她站在那、再一下跳到门口。先跟着屏幕一起淡掉
11-02 作者：一进门妮芙已经闪现在屋子深处很奇怪。改成晨先进门（妮芙不跟着一起换房间），晨进去拿起罐子以后，妮芙从门口淡入、漂过来

narr.zh: 罐子上贴着妮芙的标签：「盐，很咸，尝过了。」
narr.en: Niff's label on the jar: "Salt. Very salty. Tasted it."

home_enter._note: 跟阿汀进门一样：先听见门响，人从门里那一格淡出来、再往里走

narr.zh: 桌上摊着一个本子，第一页是妮芙写给自己的：「你叫妮芙。这是你的家。先看这个本子，再出门。」
narr.en: A notebook lies open on the table. On the first page, Niff has written to herself: "You are Niff. This is your home. Read this notebook before you go out."

home_enter.zh: 烧水，放茶……啊，跳了一步。这碗算泡好的，不许告状哦。
home_enter.en: Boil water, add tea... oh, I skipped a step. This one counts as brewed. No telling on me.

home_enter.zh: 我记不住刚发生的事。沙漏漏完一次，好多东西就找不到了。
home_enter.en: I can't remember things that just happened. Every time the hourglass runs out, a lot of it's gone.

home_enter.zh: 先说名字嘛，不然一会儿只能写‘湿湿的人’了。
home_enter.en: Name first. Otherwise I'll have to write 'the soggy one.'

options.zh: 我刚才是忙得没顾上饿。
options.en: I was too busy to notice I was hungry.
Anything that isn't sweet?

options.zh: 你这本子记得也太细了。
options.en: Your notes are really detailed.

n_kettle_b.en: Miss Niff is going to boil some water.

n_note_p.zh: 晨。飞机掉进河里，帮忙捞了杯子。肚子还饿着。
n_note_p.en: Chen. Ship fell in the river. Helped fish out the cup. Still hungry.

n_note_c.zh: 晨，取件员。飞机掉进河里，帮忙捞了杯子。肚子还饿着。
n_note_c.en: Chen, the courier. Ship fell in the river. Helped fish out the cup. Still hungry.

n_note_b.zh: 晨，妮芙小姐的传记作者。飞机掉进河里。肚子还饿着。
n_note_b.en: Chen, Miss Niff's biographer. Ship fell in the river. Still hungry.

n_note_m.zh: 晨，冒牌妈妈。飞机掉进河里，帮忙捞了杯子。肚子还饿着。
n_note_m.en: Chen, the fake mom. Ship fell in the river. Helped fish out the cup. Still hungry.

ch_bread_busy.zh: 嗯嗯，忙的时候，肚子也在忙。
ch_bread_busy.en: Mm-hm. When you're busy, your stomach's busy too.

ch_bread_sweet.zh: 有呀。这个就不甜，我尝过。
ch_bread_sweet.en: Sure. This one isn't sweet. I tasted it.

ch_bread_book.zh: 细一点好找嘛。粗了，就找不到你啦。
ch_bread_book.en: Detailed is easier to search. If I wrote less, I'd lose you.

options.zh: 我叫晨，刚才帮你捞了杯子。
options.en: I'm Chen. I just fished your cup out.
I own this house.
I'm here to collect for the bread.

rb_who_a.zh: 等一下哦，你说得比我看得快。
rb_who_a.en: Wait, you're talking faster than I can read.

rb_who_b.zh: 本子第一页写着，这是我的家。……你是来抢房子的客人吗？
rb_who_b.en: Page one says this is my house. ...Are you the kind of guest who steals houses?
Then finish your bread first, then steal it.

rb_who_c.zh: 本子上写着，面包是请客的。……你就是刚才吃得最快的那个吧。
rb_who_c.en: It says the bread was a treat. ...You're the one who ate fastest, aren't you.

home_bread_b.zh: ……写着呢：晨，捞杯子的，喜欢面包的脆边。
home_bread_b.en: Ship's on the shore. Likes the crusty edge.

home_bread_b.zh: 妮芙记不住刚发生的事，沙漏漏完会响一声铃。
home_bread_b.en: Niff can't remember what just happened, and a bell rings when the hourglass runs out.

home_bread_b.zh: 铃响以后，先等她看完本子。
home_bread_b.en: After the bell, wait for her to read her notebook.

home_postcard.zh: 来客册泡过水，在窗边晾着，干了才能翻。你瞪着它也不会快啦，我试过。
home_postcard.en: The guestbook got soaked. It's drying by the window; you can't open it till it's dry. Staring won't speed it up, I've tried.

book_peek2.zh: 边上好像干了一点。一点点。
book_peek2.en: The edges look a little drier. A little.

book_peek3.zh: 妮芙的来客册泡过水，在窗边晾着。
book_peek3.en: Niff's guestbook got soaked; it's drying by the window.

deer_msg_m.zh: 鹿借用：妈妈，到了没？今天没人让咱孝敬，有点不习惯。
deer_msg_m.en: Deer borrowing: Mom, you there yet? Nobody to wait on today. Feels weird.

deer_msg_c.zh: 鹿借用：孩子，到了没？到了回一句，咱好睡觉。
deer_msg_c.en: Deer borrowing: kid, you there yet? Send one word so I can sleep.

home_wait_talk.zh: 要是有人说会再联系你，你等了很久，还在等，你会怎么办？
home_wait_talk.en: If someone said they'd be in touch, and you waited a long time, and you're still waiting, what would you do?

home_wait_talk.zh: 我先翻翻本子呀，说不定记下来了。
home_wait_talk.en: I'd check my notebook first. Maybe I wrote it down.
But I remember she said it.

home_wait_talk.zh: 那说这句话的时候，你们在做什么呀？
home_wait_talk.en: Then what were you two doing when she said it?

lines.zh: 她说那句话的时候，我们正在——
lines.en: When she said it, we were—

home_drawing.en: What's that in your notebook... a kettle?

options.en: It's an elephant.
It's my mom.
Yep. A kettle.

dr_el.zh: 大象呀……我好像在哪儿见过很大的东西。
dr_el.en: An elephant... I think I've seen something huge somewhere.

dr_mom.zh: 你妈妈鼻子好长呀。……我也见过一个鼻子这么长的，等等！
dr_mom.en: Your mom has a really long nose. ...I've seen a nose that long too. Wait!

dr_kettle.zh: 画得真好！……水壶为什么有耳朵？我好像见过有耳朵的水壶，等等！
dr_kettle.en: It's lovely! ...Why does the kettle have ears? I think I've seen a kettle with ears. Wait!

narr.zh: 「南桥，退水后，第七日。拍到很大的动物，影子糊成一团，要再看一遍。」
narr.en: "South Bridge, seventh day after the water went down. Caught something really big, the shadow's a blur. Need to watch again."

home_drawing_b.zh: 倒回去。刚才那里，倒回去！

narr.zh: 「读取头松动，不要连续重试。」
narr.en: "Reading head loose. Don't keep retrying."

home_drawing_b.zh: 它真的坏掉的话，后面就看不到啦。
home_drawing_b.en: If it really breaks, we'll never see the rest.

options.en: Sorry. I got too impatient.
Is there anyone here who can fix it?

options.zh: 我先不碰了，你告诉我怎么弄。
options.en: I'll leave it alone. Tell me what to do.

ch_tape_sorry.en: I could tell. You really want to see it.

ch_tape_fix.zh: 有呀。就是我。……先把它包起来。
ch_tape_fix.en: There is. Me. ...Let's wrap it up first.

ch_tape_wait.en: Okay. No pressing. Let's wrap it up first.

home_tape_wrap.zh: 读取头松了，得换一个。旧仓库一层有，泡在水下。
home_tape_wrap.en: The reading head's loose. It needs a new one. The old warehouse ground floor has them, but it's underwater.
Niff has footage of the elephant.

home_tape_wrap.zh: 要换读取头，旧仓库一层有，泡在水下；妮芙有气瓶。
home_tape_wrap.en: Need a new reading head; the old warehouse ground floor has one, underwater; Niff has an air tank.

n_tank_p.zh: 我这儿有气瓶，一起下去拿吧。
n_tank_p.en: I've got an air tank. Let's go down and get one together.

n_tank_c.zh: 我这儿有气瓶。取件员，这回一起去取件吧。
n_tank_c.en: I've got an air tank. Come on, courier, let's go pick up a package together.

n_tank_b.zh: 妮芙小姐有气瓶。第二章：两个人一起下水。
n_tank_b.en: Miss Niff has an air tank. Chapter Two: Two People Go Underwater.

n_tank_m.zh: 我这儿有气瓶，冒牌妈妈也一起下去吧。
n_tank_m.en: I've got an air tank. Fake mom, you're coming down too.

home_labels.zh: 门把手上也贴着：往下按，别往上提。
home_labels.en: Even the door handle: 'Push down, don't lift.'

home_out._note: 10-31 作者「阿汀为什么是突然出现的」：阿汀在换地方的同时就站在码头桩，原来是淡入以后才 show

home_in._note: 11-02 同 home_enter：晨先进门往里走几步，妮芙再从门口淡入、漂到灶台边（在晨左边，谁也不从谁身上穿过去）

ting_footage.zh: 第十一条：旧型号读取头，只在旧仓库一层有。那一层整个泡在水里。
ting_footage.en: Regulation Eleven: old-model reading heads are only on the warehouse ground floor. That whole floor is underwater.

ting_footage.zh: 第十二条：绳子、气瓶、回程水位，少一样，罚你陪妮芙喝淡茶。
ting_footage.en: Regulation Twelve: rope, air tank, return water level. Miss one and you're sentenced to weak tea with Niff.

rows.en: Water level for the way back

ting_footage.spec: 【妮芙篇探索顺序：河岸住处—高处市集—旧街水闸—水下仓库—南桥。记忆变化由关键剧情节点触发，已完成的小游戏进度保留，重复介绍的对话随剧情推进。关键任务记录始终可以查看。】

market_go._note: 10-30 作者：原来妮芙在三个摊子之间来回走完才放手（54 秒动不了）。现在不锁晨：她先飘去修补摊看门边的标记，晨自己往借气瓶的摊子走，她看完会跟上来

market_breather.en: These biscuits aren't too sweet. Want some?

market_breather.zh: 这个不能靠着油壶哦，饼干会学到怪味道的。
market_breather.en: Don't keep that by the oil can. The biscuits will pick up weird flavors.

market_baskets.zh: 篮子吊在栏杆外，买菜就往上拉。
market_baskets.en: Baskets hang off the railing. Buy groceries, pull them up.

market_tool_stall.zh: 有一把扳手，和弥洛那把很像。
market_tool_stall.en: One wrench looks a lot like Milo's.

market_bridge.zh: 屋顶之间的桥都很细，低处的街全在水里。
market_bridge.en: The bridges between roofs are narrow. The low streets are all underwater.

market_keeper.zh: 她每回都写归还地点，每回都还了。
market_keeper.en: She writes down where to return it every time. And returns it every time.

oldstreet_go._note: 10-31：从楼梯间下来（楼梯间 room.json 的 portal：pan_down，渐黑 + 镜头往下）。原来接着 show 妮芙到 oldstreet_niff，淡入以后她会跳一下；with 已经把她放在晨旁边，删了

oldstreet_back._note: 10-31：回市集先上楼梯间（旧街 room.json 的 portal：pan_up，渐黑 + 镜头往上）

stairwell_jelly._note: 10-31：站到柜台左头再说话（水母在柜台右边），晨不挡住她

stairwell_jelly.zh: 下楼小心第三级台阶。我没有脚，一直没弄明白它哪里不对。
stairwell_jelly.en: Mind the third step going down. I don't have feet, so I never figured out what's wrong with it.

oldstreet_marks.zh: 墙上是不同年份的水位刻线。
oldstreet_marks.en: Water lines from different years on the wall.

sluice.spec: 【小游戏一：水闸调节。观察水位、辨听管道声并选择开闸顺序，使旧街踏步露出。错误操作只让水位回到上一个稳定状态，不损失剧情物品。防水板保留已经验证的结果，避免玩家与妮芙重复试错。】

intro.zh: 大的先别转呀，等这边不冒泡了再试。
intro.en: Don't turn the big one yet. Wait till this side stops bubbling.

first_set.zh: 等一下，先把刻度记到板上嘛。
first_set.en: Wait, write the setting on the board first.

wrong_1.en: Not this notch. I'll put an X.

dry_1.zh: 转得动，可这根管子一点声音都没有。
dry_1.en: It turns, but this pipe doesn't make a sound.

already.zh: 这道记过啦，板上写着呢。
already.en: We did this one already. It's on the board.

big_early.zh: 还在冒泡呢，大的再等等。
big_early.en: Still bubbling. The big one has to wait.

look_pipes.zh: 咕噜声是从这根管子里来的。
look_pipes.en: The gurgling's coming from this pipe.

look_marks_0.zh: 水还停在最上面那条刻线。
look_marks_0.en: The water's still up at the top line.

look_marks_1.en: The water's down to the next line.

look_marks_2.zh: 又退了一条。踏步快露出来了。
look_marks_2.en: Down another line. The steps are nearly out.

oldstreet_signs.zh: 上下两层，门上是同一个店名。
oldstreet_signs.en: Two levels, the same shop name over both doors.

oldstreet_corner.zh: 以前从这里能买果酱。脚还记得，店已经不在啦。
oldstreet_corner.en: You used to be able to buy jam here. My feet remember. The shop's gone.

oldstreet_corner.zh: 旧街的墙上有一排身高刻线。最上面的红线是洪水那天，比妮芙高很多。
oldstreet_corner.en: A row of height marks on an Old Street wall. The red line at the top is the day of the flood, far above Niff's head.

rows.en: Way back: toward the exit light

warehouse_go.zh: 我要是看着像要乱走，就把这块板子给我看。
warehouse_go.en: If I look like I'm wandering off, show me this board.

warehouse_go._note: 10-30 作者：进仓库这段等太久（原来晨自动走过整片开阔海底才放手）。下水以后就放手，晨自己游到箱子跟前触发 warehouse_in（hotspot wh_in）

narr.zh: 箱子上贴着妮芙的标签：「借来的」「还不知道是谁的，先放好」
narr.en: Niff's labels on the crates: "Borrowed." "Don't know whose yet. Keep safe."

tag.zh: 一包密封圈。泡过水，没裂。
tag.en: A pack of seals. Soaked, but not cracked.
Knobs, a coil of fine wire.

label.zh: 什么都不拿，顺着导绳回去
label.en: Take nothing, follow the rope back

warehouse_in.spec: 【小游戏二：水下仓库。玩家利用浮箱改变柜子的受力位置，拉开堵住内门的家具，再按设备标签找到读取头。导绳、出口灯和明确的绳结提供导航，气量不设置紧迫倒计时。完成主目标后，可顺路取回少量旧物和修船零件。】

narr.zh: 家具被倒下的柜子压着。把左边的浮箱拴到柜子上，也许能浮起来。
narr.en: The furniture's pinned under the toppled cabinet. Tie the float box on the left to the cabinet and it might lift.

narr.zh: 柜顶那头压着家具。柜顶和柜脚各有一个拴环。
narr.en: The top end is pinning the furniture. There's a ring at the top and one at the foot.

narr.zh: 柜脚浮起来了，压着家具的那头反而更沉。
narr.en: The foot floated up. The end on the furniture sank even lower.

narr.zh: 泄水门的操作记录。最后一次开闸，签名是妮芙。
narr.en: The sluice gate log. The last time it was opened, Niff signed it.

narr.zh: 记录背面是妮芙的字：「再看一遍。阿汀已经确认，船上还有人。」
narr.en: Niff's handwriting on the back: "Check again. Ting confirmed: people still on the boat."

narr.zh: 「箱子拿不完。不要为了回来拿箱子，再把闸关上。」
narr.en: "We can't take all the crates. Don't come back for them and close the gate again."

narr.zh: 又是妮芙的标签：「借来的」
narr.en: Another of Niff's labels: "Borrowed."

home_coat.name: door_touch
home_coat._note: 10-31 作者「阿汀为什么是突然出现的」：跟在后面进门——先听见门响，人从门里淡出来、往里走两步站到门边（晨在 154，他个子大，离晨至少 85）
river_home_labels = 屋里门左边那一格（l0 x 28），门里面

home_coat.zh: 嗯。那天水涨得太快，是你开的门。
home_coat.en: Yes. The water rose too fast that day. You opened the gate.

home_coat.zh: 那你为什么一直说是来不及搬？
home_coat.en: Then why did you always say there wasn't time to move things?
I was afraid you'd go back down looking.

home_coat_b._note: 10-31 阿汀走：走到门口、门响、淡出去（不原地消失）

home_coat_b.en: Made it to the river city.

home_coat_b.zh: 我老记着她最后没回我，前面我们到底说过什么，反倒一直没往回看。
home_coat_b.en: I keep thinking about how she never wrote back. I never scrolled up to see what we'd said before that.

tape_fix.zh: 往南边去了！看到了吗，桥洞下面！
tape_fix.en: It went south! See it? Under the bridge!
Notch in the left ear. Recognizable.

tape_fix.zh: 有人说过，找到大象就会再联系我。
tape_fix.en: Someone told me: find the elephant, and we'll talk again.

tape_fix.zh: 可你现在已经看见大象了呀。
tape_fix.en: But you've seen the elephant now.

tape_fix.zh: 也许要真的到它旁边才算。
tape_fix.en: Maybe it only counts if I'm right next to it.

label.zh: 它在拉缆绳，把浮灯拉歪了。
label.en: It's pulling the cable. The floating lamps went crooked.
It seems to want to climb out by the bridge.

label.zh: 左耳缺了一块。不知道疼不疼。
label.en: A piece of its left ear is missing. I wonder if it hurts.

el_rope.zh: 它用鼻子拉缆绳，浮灯一整排都歪了。
el_rope.en: It pulled the cable with its nose. A whole row of floating lamps went crooked.

el_climb.zh: 它好像想从桥边上岸，鼻子搭上石沿又滑下去了。
el_climb.en: It seemed to want to climb out by the bridge, got its trunk on the ledge and slid back.

el_ear.zh: 左耳缺了一块，不知道疼不疼。
el_ear.en: A piece of its left ear is missing. I wonder if it hurts.

tape_sound.en: Wow, it really has a voice!

tape_sound.zh: 这里能不能再写，我们都很高兴？
tape_sound.en: Can you also write here that we were both happy?

tape_sound.zh: 可以呀。以后我就知道，这里要高兴一下。
tape_sound.en: Sure. Then later I'll know to be happy here.

guestbook.name: door_touch
guestbook._note: 10-31 作者「阿汀为什么是突然出现的」：原来妮芙念完一大段，阿汀直接出现在阁楼上。改成一开始楼下门响，他从门口进来，自己沿石阶慢慢走上二层（不等），停在去阁楼的楼梯口仰头说话（阁楼只有 220 宽，晨、妮芙站在窗边以后再站一个大个子的阿汀就叠上了）；轮到他说话时还没到就等他走到

guestbook.zh: 从森林来的客人，怕甜，会修东西。不要问她为什么不写回信。
guestbook.en: A guest from the forest. Doesn't like sweets, good at fixing things. Don't ask her why she never wrote back.

guestbook.zh: 来客册的旧照片：袖口那块补丁，和弥洛窗边椅子上那件旧外套很像。
guestbook.en: Old photo in the guestbook: the patch on the cuff looks like the old coat on the chair by Milo's window.

guestbook.zh: 弥洛的朋友洪水以后又留了一阵，后来跟着补给船去了云层星。
guestbook.en: Milo's friend stayed a while after the flood, then left for the Cloud Planet on a supply ship.

guestbook.zh: 她给弥洛写过信，投进了北岸的旧邮箱，里面有新住址和通讯号码。
guestbook.en: She did write to Milo. She put it in the old north bank mailbox, with her new address and contact number inside.

guestbook.zh: 北岸那只旧邮箱？后一次涨水冲走了，里面的信没来得及取。
guestbook.en: The old north bank mailbox? The next flood washed it away. Nobody got the letters out.

guestbook._note: 10-31 说完就下楼回门口（不等）；guestbook_cup 末尾走到门口、门响、淡出去

guestbook.zh: 弥洛的朋友离开的日期和补给船的船名，从来客册上抄下来了。
guestbook.en: Copied the date Milo's friend left and the supply ship's name from the guestbook.

guestbook.zh: 这个要告诉弥洛哦。等一封没收到的信，会等错地方的。
guestbook.en: You have to tell Milo. If you wait for a letter that never arrived, you wait in the wrong place.

options.zh: 我会把日期和船名一起带回去。
options.en: I'll take the date and the ship's name back with me.

options.zh: 杯子也能让我带去给她看吗？
options.en: Can I take the cup to show her too?
So she really did write.

ch_letter_bring.en: Mm. Don't copy the ship's name wrong.

ch_letter_wrote.en: She did. It just never got there.

guestbook_cup.zh: 杯子先放这儿。人家说了要来拿，我也答应啦。
guestbook_cup.en: The cup stays here. She said she'd come for it, and I promised.

south_go.zh: 南桥：走错了一个桥洞，重新标了灯柱。
south_go.en: South Bridge: went to the wrong arch, re-marked the lamp post.

south_go.spec: 【小游戏三：还原拍摄位置。玩家对照影像里的桥洞、灯柱与浮灯方向，找到正确的观察点，再结合当前水位确认动物经过的水道。完成后显露旧运输水道的入口，不依赖快速反应或记忆倒计时。】

start.zh: 影像是从桥这边拍的，灯柱和桥洞要一起对上。
start.en: The footage was shot from this side. Line up the lamp post and the arch.

ask.zh: 浮灯都往一边歪。它是从哪个桥洞过去的？
ask.en: The floating lamps all lean one way. Which arch did it go through?

wrong_southbridge_arch_far.en: The lamps weren't leaning this way.

south_go.zh: 好大。它要是踩过来，我得早点让路呀。
south_go.en: So big. If it stepped this way, I'd have to move early.

south_go.zh: 南桥桥洞的脚印和森林里的速写差不多大，是不是同一只还待确认。
south_go.en: The footprint under South Bridge is about the size of the forest sketch; still not sure it's the same one.

south_lamp.zh: 影像里那排浮灯，就挂在这根灯柱上。
south_lamp.en: The floating lamps in the footage hung from this post.

south_ornament.zh: 从上面看是栏杆，从下面看是别人家的屋顶。
south_ornament.en: From above, a railing. From below, someone's roof.

niff_chat_south.zh: 我们来找什么来着？……啊，大象。对对。
niff_chat_south.en: What were we looking for? ...Oh, the elephant. Right, right.

narr.zh: 旧装卸记录：一行一个编号，后面写着船和去向。
narr.en: Old loading records: one number per line, then the ship and where it went.

dock_plates.spec: 水道尽头是一处废弃货台，墙上的航线图已经脱落，只剩几块编号牌。玩家把编号牌与旧装卸记录对应，能确认这里曾经停靠前往云层星的运输船。

narr.zh: 「07　补给船　去往东岸」
narr.en: "07  Supply ship  To the east bank"

narr.zh: 「12　运输船　去往云层星」
narr.en: "12  Transport ship  To the Cloud Planet"

dock_plate_12.en: I found the ship it took.

dock_plate_12.zh: 找到啦？那就多看一会儿嘛，不要刚找到就急着走。
dock_plate_12.en: Found it? Then look a little longer. Don't rush off the moment you find it.

dock_plate_12.zh: 货台旧照片上它在上坡板，左耳缺了一角，背面船号和航线图终点对得上。
dock_plate_12.en: In the old dock photo it's on the ramp, a notch in its left ear, and the boat number on the back matches the route map.

dock_plate_12.zh: 这里的人后来还见过它吗？
dock_plate_12.en: Did anyone here ever see it again?

narr.zh: 「21　渡船　去往下游船坞」
narr.en: "21  Ferry  To the downstream boatyard"

south_back._note: 10-30：原来接着把妮芙 show 到旧街左头（70），再让她游 1000 多像素到钩子这里，晨干等 15 秒；fade_to 的 with 已经把她放在晨旁边

south_back.zh: 这个原来挂在我的小船上，回来的时候摇一摇，岸上就知道了。
south_back.en: This used to hang on my little boat. Ring it on the way back and the shore knows.

south_back.zh: 送给你啦，以后就是你的了。
妮芙送的铜铃，标签背面画的小飞机，机翼歪得和我那架差不多。
south_back.en: Niff's copper bell; the little ship on the back of the tag has wings as crooked as mine.

plane_fix.zh: 接口拧回去的时候，反方向。
plane_fix.en: When you screw the joint back in: the other way.

farewell.zh: 在我本子上留点什么吧，画什么都行。
farewell.en: Leave something in my notebook. Draw anything.

narr.zh: 新标签：「你可以用这个去找大象啦。找到了，记得回来告诉我。」
narr.en: New label: "You can use this to find the elephant. When you do, come back and tell me."

farewell.zh: 阿汀给你晾的浮木。他说第三十条：吃的不许混进去烧。
farewell.en: Ting dried this driftwood for you. He says Regulation Thirty: no food goes in the fire.

farewell.zh: 阿汀托妮芙给了一袋晾干的浮木，可以烧。
farewell.en: Ting sent a bag of dried driftwood through Niff, for burning.

options.en: I'll write down what I see, a little at a time.

options.zh: 画得不好，你也得认出来。
options.en: Even if it's badly drawn, you have to recognize it.

options.zh: 下次别先把我写成湿湿的人。
options.en: Next time, don't write me down as the soggy one.

narr.zh: 瓶子上的标签改了：「寄件人：妮芙小姐」
narr.en: The bottle's label has been changed: "Sender: Miss Niff"

narr.zh: 本子封面：「妮芙小姐传记（第一章）」，后面都还空着。
narr.en: The notebook cover: "The Life of Miss Niff (Chapter One)". Everything after it is blank.

n_gift_m.zh: 冒牌妈妈路上小心。我会跟下游那个真的说一声。
n_gift_m.en: Safe travels, fake mom. I'll let the real one downstream know.

n_tea_p.zh: 这次先放茶啦。本子上写着。
n_tea_p.en: Tea first this time. It's in the notebook.

n_tea_c.zh: 取件员，这次先放茶啦。本子上写着。
n_tea_c.en: Courier, I put the tea in first this time. It's in my notebook.

n_tea_b.zh: 妮芙小姐这次先放了茶。本子上写着。
n_tea_b.en: This time Miss Niff put the tea in first. It's in her notebook.

n_tea_m.zh: 冒牌妈妈，这次先放茶啦。本子上写着。
n_tea_m.en: Fake mom, I put the tea in first this time. It's in my notebook.

ch_bye_draw.zh: 认得出来呀。有补丁的是阿汀。
ch_bye_draw.en: I can tell. The one with the patch is Ting.

ch_bye_wet.zh: 那要看你下次湿不湿啦。
ch_bye_wet.en: Depends on whether you're soggy next time.

farewell_b.zh: 你画的这个……还是像水壶。
farewell_b.en: What you drew... still looks like a kettle.

farewell_b.zh: 不是水壶。鼻子本来就是这么长。
farewell_b.en: It's not a kettle. The nose is supposed to be that long.

farewell_b.zh: 妮芙那一页写着：晨要去云层星找大象，走之前说过再见了。
farewell_b.en: Niff's page says: Chen is going to the Cloud Planet to find the elephant, and said goodbye first.

farewell_phone.zh: 这样你发消息，我就知道是你啦。要写清楚哦，光发一个‘到了’，我会想好久的。
farewell_phone.en: This way I'll know it's you when you message. Write it clearly. If you just send 'here,' I'll wonder for ages.

depart.zh: 妮芙今天把茶叶放对了。
depart.en: Niff got the tea right today.
